name: Touch My Heart
original_name: タッチ マイ ハート
source:
While on the way home from work a mysterious woman begs hero to let her in the car and help her escape from the pursuers. It's up to hero what happens next.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-march-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
下班回家的路上，一名神秘女子恳求主人公让她上车，帮助她摆脱追赶者。接下来会发生什么，完全取决于主人公的选择。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-march-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
